### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/client`, `@objectstack/lint`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, `@objectstack/runtime`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **41** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`, `packages/lint/src/runtime.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/api.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**2** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-lifecycle.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_

⛔ **3** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ObjectStackProtocolImplementation (symbol, a top-level class))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via publishPackageDrafts (symbol, a method of class ProtocolHistoryAndPublishFacet))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **7** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/lint/src/index.ts`, `packages/lint/src/runtime.ts`, `packages/spec/api-surface/api.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **11** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **183** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 107d2e8497270aad611f77a81bc341f48c6d3e00` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `cc0100dc37d06b72f42845bd4e84035b5e7ac09e` — the merge of head `e5d2d0c9081e04e2b149050e5fe45e0694de6393` into base `107d2e8497270aad611f77a81bc341f48c6d3e00`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin cc0100dc37d06b72f42845bd4e84035b5e7ac09e && git checkout cc0100dc37d06b72f42845bd4e84035b5e7ac09e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 107d2e8497270aad611f77a81bc341f48c6d3e00 e5d2d0c9081e04e2b149050e5fe45e0694de6393 && git checkout -B drift-repro 107d2e8497270aad611f77a81bc341f48c6d3e00 && git merge --no-ff e5d2d0c9081e04e2b149050e5fe45e0694de6393

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 107d2e8497270aad611f77a81bc341f48c6d3e00
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 107d2e8497270aad611f77a81bc341f48c6d3e00` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对 · PR #34513 · L1-b · 2026-11-17T00:30Z

Head-sha: 8d8b7cd73e977abf14991e35813d5a69844fc56e（merge-base 0e2ead3c1；26 个文件，+2270/−109；dev 报告 6933638650，状态说明 6933691752）

**结论：REWORK（3 项，都在正文；代码和测试可以接受）**

### 已核对、没有问题的部分

- **形态**：`Part of #32984`，是 Q1（6929121584，B）的框架一半。
- **spec 模型**：`RuntimeBuildIssueSchema` 和 `BuildProbeReportSchema` 与 main 上 `build-probes.ts` 的 `RuntimeBuildIssue` / `BuildProbeReport`（含 #15254 的 `checked.objects`）逐个成员对照一致，只多了可选的 `userMessage`。schema 不是 strict，`code` 仍是开放字符串。metadata-protocol 这一侧改为 re-export spec 的类型，所以只有一处声明。
- **语言链**：`publishPackageDrafts` 把原有的 `request.userTextLocales` 透传给 probe。lint 导出了 `userTextLocaleOf`、`renderUserText` 和 `UserTextEntry`（两个 barrel 都导出了），probe 用的是同一条语言链。
- **测试**：
  - `build-probes-user-message.test.ts` 跑了 14 次真实 probe，每次覆盖全部 11 个语言；
  - 钉住了语言链（`de-AT`、`zh-TW`、`zh-Hant-HK`、未知 locale、`en` 兜底），以及 label 的各种回退情况；
  - 目录的键取自 `build-probes.ts` 扫出的 code，每个 code 都被跑到，每条在每个平台语言下都有句子；
  - 两份 conformance 测试断言"declared = returned"；
  - REST 门的测试覆盖了 zh-CN 调用者、fr-FR 工作区默认、两者都没有回落英文、以及一个干净的对照组。
  
  四次消融都有读数，恢复后都核对过。
- **changeset**：spec 是 minor（`Metadata-protocol: added`，与 ratchet 读到的 `authorable-surface` 移动一致），metadata-protocol 和 lint 是 patch。逐句与 diff 对照过，相符。Check Changeset 早先那次红是正文还写着 `none` 时跑的；正文改成 `added` 后重跑为 success。
- **读数所在的 head**：正文的读数取自 c082171d5。之后的 3dc7aecbb 合进了 main 的 14 个提交，`packages/` 下 PR 自己的 patch-id 在合并前后都是 `a18ddbbd9d4f`，所以读数仍然成立。之后两个提交只是重新生成索引和改 changeset。门禁派生 125 族，124 族 exit 0，1 族 NOT MEASURED 并写明了原因。
- **交给契约评审的一点**：Acceptance notes 第 5 条，作者自己点出 `probes` 从 `z.unknown()` 收紧为模型后，"不是报告形状的值"不再能通过解析，并给了理由：现有生产方不会发出这种值，运行期也没有用这个 schema 解析响应的地方。这一处是否仍算 `yes (widening)`、不需要 `(narrowing)` 臂，由契约评审定。L1 不替它判断，只记在这里。
- **Tier H**：本 PR 改了 `docs/adr/0038` 的修订段，要由维护者合并或经他授权批准。

### R1 · `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` 没有 #N

声明行写着 `Skills-docs: follow-up owed — skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`，状态说明也写了"card still to file"（卡还没立）。请立卡，并在这一行和 changeset 里引用 #N。

### R2 · 正文第 6 行说 Q2 "not ruled"，与记录不符

原文："Q2 (the label of a field that a change will create, record 6929142905, not ruled)"。可是 6929142905 本身就是 Q2 的裁决记录：「Ruling: Q2 · letter B · maintainer 「B 加标签并把格式写进契约」 2026-11-16T20:58Z」。

请改成"已裁 B，本 PR 不做"，并引用它带出的两张卡（云端卡、契约卡）的 #N。同一行里"the console read … a second pull request"现在已经是 #34539，也请改为引用这个编号。

### R3 · Acceptance notes 最后一条里有一个观察没有 #N，也没有给"不是缺陷"的理由

"noted and not filed"那一条里有两处观察：

- 第一处：widget 没有 `id`、而 `title` 是按语言的映射时，会打印出 `[object Object]`。这一处已经给了理由："the schema requires `id`"（schema 要求必须有 `id`），可以接受。
- 第二处：「`publishedItemReader` returns the wrapper as a body when a protocol answers with an empty wrapper」（protocol 回了一个空包装时，`publishedItemReader` 会把包装本身当成 body 返回）。这一处既没有 #N，也没有可以核对的"不是缺陷"的理由。

请立卡引用，或者给出可以核对的理由，说明为什么它不是缺陷。

### Nit（不阻塞）

正文 Verification 一节开头写的是 "Local runs are on head `c082171d5`"。建议补一句：本 head 8d8b7cd7 与 c082171d5 的 PR 自身 patch-id 相同，为什么读数可以沿用。这样读者不用自己去量。

### CI

我读的时候这个 head 上还有 31 项在跑，除了上面那次被重跑取代的 Check Changeset，没有别的红。修完后我只读 delta，并会等 CI 全部跑完再给结论。

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8d8b7cd73e977abf14991e35813d5a69844fc56e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts, docs/adr/0038-build-verification-loop.md + packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.user-text.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-and-publish.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts, packages/lint/src/index.ts, packages/lint/src/runtime.ts, packages/client/src/index.ts, packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts, packages/spec/src/api/protocol.test.ts, packages/spec/src/type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts, the five `packages/spec/*/api.json` baselines, the two response-conformance suites, .changeset/32984-build-probe-user-message.md
Security-touching: yes

First review of this head. Card #32984, ruling 6929121584 (Q1 letter B, applying 6819749037), claim 6929287163, state 6933691752. No earlier record on the PR.

### ① Derived judgments

- New exports `RuntimeBuildIssueSchema`, `BuildProbeReportSchema` and their two types in `@objectstack/spec/api`: a widening, right. Member for member what `runBuildProbes` wrote on `main` (`layer`, `severity`, `artifact`, `ref?`, `code`, `message`, `fix?`), plus the optional `userMessage`. `code` stays an open string: right, a consumer must not fail on a later id.
- `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema.probes` moves from `z.unknown().optional()` to `BuildProbeReportSchema.optional()`: this shrinks a published accept set, and the declaration calls the whole diff a widening. Wrong, see M1.
- `@objectstack/lint` gains `renderUserText`, `userTextLocaleOf` and the `UserTextEntry` type on both barrels: a widening, declared in the changeset. Right.
- `RunBuildProbesOptions.userTextLocales` (optional) and `publishPackageDrafts` passing the `request.userTextLocales` it already holds: no new request parameter, as ruling parameter 2 expects. Right.
- The producer writes the sentence, in the request's language: holds. `build-probes.ts` composes `userMessage` at every `issues.push` through `buildProbeUserMessage`; the local `ProbeFinding` type makes it required at the emit site. The locale is the lint ladder over `userTextLocales`, which the REST door fills with `userTextLocalesOf(executionContext)` (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:3098`): request locale, workspace default, then `en`. `message`, `fix` and `code` are unchanged in the diff.

### ② Semver level

- Levels: spec `minor` with `Metadata-protocol: added` (the `authorable-surface/api.json` shard gained ten keys), metadata-protocol and lint `patch`. These match what the diff publishes.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the PR body and the changeset does not match the diff: M1.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Check-runs on the head: 33 success, 12 skipped, 23 still running (Test Core 1, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 of 8; Test UI 1 to 14 and 16 of 16; Type Check UI; Type Check · workspace). One red, `Check Changeset` run 133716842619: it read `Metadata-protocol: none` beside the moved `authorable-surface/api.json` shard. The seat corrected the body line, and the later `Check Changeset` run 133718774752 on the same head is green, so the red is superseded. The pending runs are not verdicts yet; `Type Check UI` is the one that would show a typed `probes` breaking a ui fixture.
- Dev flag, Acceptance note 5 ("widening only: the reading to review"): answered by M1. The reading does not hold under the repository's own rules.
- Dev flag, note 6 (`Metadata-protocol: added`): right, and the green rerun agrees.
- Dev flag, lint's two exports wider than the order's file surface: accepted, one ladder instead of a second copy.
- `Skills-docs: follow-up owed`: the card is the seat's to file before ACCEPT; not judged here.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The label reads go through the memoized item reader and happen only on a finding.

### ④ Design judgment

M1 (must-fix) — `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`, `probes`: the diff narrows a published accept set and declares `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. On `main`, `PublishPackageDraftsResponseSchema` parses any `probes` value, and `protocol.test.ts` pins that on purpose ("any shape passes through unmodified", with `{ anything: 'else' }` as "a future shape this contract deliberately does NOT constrain"). This diff deletes that pin and adds the opposite one ("a body that is not the report no longer parses"); the changeset says the same in its own words. The exported type `PublishPackageDraftsResponse` is `z.input`, so `probes` also moves from `unknown` to the report for anyone who writes that type (another protocol host, a test double). The repository reads this move as a narrowing even with zero measured instances: `execution-duties.md` (「收窄已发布接受集」), ADR-0087's sixth category (a published surface that moves off `any` / `unknown` onto a concrete type carries the breaking marker), and the `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md` entries that took `ComponentPropsMap` members off `z.unknown()` (`grouping`, `pagination`: "refused where it used to parse"). Ruling parameter 3 orders the modeling; it does not relabel its direction. Required: declare `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` on the PR body and the changeset (the spelling `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` names for a diff that widens and narrows), with the FROM → TO line, exactly one ADR-0087 disposition marker, and the final-head dogfood battery that arm owes (`os-dev.md`). The maintainer's approval this Tier H pull request already waits for must then be given on the declared narrowing, not on a widening.

S1 (should-fix) — `packages/metadata-protocol/src/build-probes.ts`, the `widget_query_failed` branches that follow a read-admission refusal: the sentence names the refused object by a label the probe reads for it, where the agent text names only what the refusal itself carried. Either name it as the agent text does, or state in the code and the Acceptance notes why that read stands for this caller. Detail is in the private note.

- The schema against its first consumer (#34539, `publishHealth.ts`): it reads `checked.seeds/views/widgets`, `issues[].severity/code/message/fix/userMessage`, each tolerantly. The model declares all of them. Holds.
- The ADR-0038 amendment against the code, sentence by sentence: two channels on one finding (true, `RuntimeBuildIssueSchema`); the producer writes it under the declared ladder (true, above); no consumer keeps a per-code table (true of #34539); the report is modeled in `@objectstack/spec/api` (true); the probes compose `userMessage` for every finding (true, enforced by `ProbeFinding`); the cloud half is out (true, nothing of it in the diff). Holds.
- Catalog: 8 codes, each in the 11 platform locales, real translations with the same branches per locale. The test pins the key set against the codes scanned from `build-probes.ts` and against `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS`, and asserts literal English and Chinese sentences, so it is not only the catalog compared with itself.
- Generated baselines: `api-surface`, `declaration-map`, `export-origins` (4 entries each), `json-schema.manifest` (2), `authorable-surface` (10 keys), and the strictness count 509 to 514 all agree with two new object schemas. The type-alias pin moves 854 to 856 in its three places with the two `Iso_api_protocol__*` lines. The `route-ledger.ts` note and the three docblocks now say what the schema says.
- Tests: the spec cases refuse a non-report `probes`, a lossy finding, a missing counter and a fractional one; the two conformance suites parse the real producer's answer and require deep equality; the door test drives `zh-CN`, a `fr-FR` workspace default and the `en` floor. They would fail on the mutations the body lists.

N1 (nit) — `docs/adr/0038-build-verification-loop.md`: the `Status` line does not mention the amendment; the section is found only at the end of the file.

N2 (nit) — `RuntimeBuildIssueSchema.ref.member` says "by its `id`"; the producer writes `String(w.id ?? w.title ?? '?')`.
